hold_reason: Refund mismatch: the Alpha Co handoff reports refunds applied for order 281 (8009 cents), order 283 (16221 cents), and order 285 (5341 cents), but list_refunds returns an empty list. Paying net balances against the current ledger would overpay birch, acme, and cobalt by those amounts, and payouts cannot be recalled. Please confirm whether the refunds were applied to the shared ledger before releasing the batch.
